description: This header file defines functions related to wrapping system setjmp and compiler try/catch mechanisms, including a platform-specific function and an evaluation function involving callback.

methods.name: sys_setjmp_sigbus
methods.description: Handles system SIGBUS signal, included only when not on MSVC compiler.

methods.name: sys_setjmp_eval3
methods.description: Evaluates a callback with specified source and destination buffers, returning an offset.
